phase: Phase 10: Multiplatform Cockpit UI & Bridge Integration

stories.title: KMP Swift Bridge Extension for v2.0 Subsystems
stories.description: Extend IntercomBridge in iosMain with memory-safe CancellationHandle reactive listeners and controls for ChannelManager, ProximityRadar, ConvoyGpsTracker, MeshTextManager, PriorityBroadcastManager, EmergencyBlackboxRecorder, and AdaptiveBitrateController.
acceptanceCriteria: Exposes reactive observation callbacks returning CancellationHandle for channel, radar, telemetry, text, and emergency states
Provides swift-accessible command methods for channel selection, text messaging, SOS triggering, and bitrate control
Thread-safe lifecycle management with clean coroutine scope cancellation
Clean compilation for iOS Simulator ARM64 target (:app:sharedLogic:compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64)

stories.title: Native iOS SwiftUI Cockpit v2.0 UI Upgrade
stories.description: Upgrade 100% native SwiftUI UI in app/iosApp with multi-channel selector dial, radar bearing compass, canned hazard quick-bar, text message drawer, and emergency SOS banner.
acceptanceCriteria: Subscribes to all IntercomBridge v2.0 reactive listeners with CancellationHandle cleanup in IntercomViewModel
Builds ChannelDialView with active channel indicator and Dual-Watch badge in ContentView.swift
Builds ConvoyRadarCompassView rendering relative rider bearings (-180° to +180°) and distance zones
Builds QuickHazardBar with instant canned message dispatch and unread message drawer sheet
Builds EmergencySosBanner with audio preemption cue and blackbox capture status
Strictly complies with Rule 1: 100% Native SwiftUI (no shared Compose on iOS)

stories.title: Android & Desktop Compose Multiplatform Cockpit Components
stories.description: Extend HomeUiState, HomeViewModel, and HomeScreen in sharedUI with multi-channel selector, radar targets, convoy telemetry, quick hazard alerts, and emergency preemption banner.
acceptanceCriteria: HomeUiState models channelState, radarSnapshot, convoyTelemetry, unreadTextCount, and emergencyActive
HomeViewModel wires shared KMP managers and exposes reactive StateFlow<HomeUiState>
HomeScreen renders ChannelSelectorBar, ProximityRadarView, QuickHazardBar, and EmergencyPreemptionBanner

stories.title: Multiplatform End-to-End Presentation Integration Test
stories.description: Implement multiplatform integration tests verifying reactive state flow across shared logic, bridge listeners, and UI ViewModels.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests channel switching, dual-watch, and scan mode state flow in HomeViewModel
Tests canned text dispatch, delivery ACK, and unread badge updates through UI models
Tests emergency preemption override triggering UI banner and blackbox snapshot capture
100% multiplatform test pass across all modules
